qualification.permanent_alpha_allocator: SequentialQualificationR27 after numerical and persistence audit

calibration.binning: equal-width [0,1], fixed before validation; p=1 belongs to last bin
calibration.empty_bin_policy: zero weight in ECE; NOT_EVALUATED outside observed support
calibration.sparse_bin_policy: include all samples in ECE; report unsupported mass; never discard sparse errors
calibration.uncertainty: report per-bin intervals and time-block sensitivity; point ECE is not a future calibration guarantee
calibration.evaluation_role: fixed post-fit calibration validation; no reuse for fitting
calibration.certificate_identity: calibrator fitted before future registration; changing it starts a new policy evaluation

loss_streak.monitoring: single registered risk-window check or valid anytime method; repeated unadjusted tail checks forbidden
loss_streak.action: risk review and pause on registered limit; never change staking

settlement_order.consume_order: registered calendar order with contiguous cursor
settlement_order.out_of_order: buffer later outcomes; block e-process cursor at unresolved earlier ACT outcome
settlement_order.missing_draw: persist pending and retry; never permanently mark unscorable after two issues
settlement_order.terminal_missing: pre-registered conservative accounting or evidence-segment closure; no observed-outcome-driven exclusions
settlement_order.duplicate_receipt: same key and payload -> no-op; different payload -> conflict; no new evidence

frequency_scope.pre_activation: FUTURE ACT decisions / all scheduled confirmation opportunities
frequency_scope.post_activation: REAL decisions / all scheduled deployment opportunities

publication_condition: These defaults require host fault/negative-control/power verification, device verification and policy-versioned activation; never silently replace historical certificate conditions. R29.1 corrects the proposed calibration support rule only; old app certificates are not reinterpreted.
